# Security Checklist: Backend Tenant Isolation RLS Hardening

**Purpose**: Validate security, privacy, auth, audit, and data-boundary
requirement quality before task generation.
**Created**: 2026-06-15
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `$speckit-checklist` command based
on feature context and requirements.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are all current tenant-owned backend table families explicitly covered by requirements? [Completeness, Spec §FR-007, §FR-008, Data Model §Table Isolation Classifications]
- [x] CHK002 Are missing-context, mismatched-context, stale-session, and revoked-device failure modes defined? [Coverage, Spec §FR-002, §FR-010, §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK003 Are request, worker, and maintenance actor contexts all specified with distinct security boundaries? [Completeness, Spec §FR-005, §FR-006, Contract tenant-context.md]
- [x] CHK004 Are API access outcomes specified for cross-tenant reads, cross-tenant mutations, and missing tenant context? [Completeness, Spec §FR-014, §FR-015, §FR-016, Contract access-outcomes.md]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK005 Is "maintenance context" defined tightly enough to prevent product UI or product RBAC bypass ambiguity? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004, §FR-006, §FR-023]
- [x] CHK006 Is the privacy-preserving read behavior clear enough to avoid tenant enumeration? [Clarity, Spec §FR-014, Contract access-outcomes.md]
- [x] CHK007 Are metadata-only evidence requirements specific about forbidden content and secret classes? [Clarity, Spec §FR-021, §SC-009]
- [x] CHK008 Are future-table isolation requirements clear enough for later feature authors? [Clarity, Spec §FR-026, Data Model §Future Table Requirement]

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK009 Do spec, plan, and contracts consistently reject product-admin bypass settings? [Consistency, Spec §FR-004, Plan §Constraints, Contract tenant-context.md]
- [x] CHK010 Do rollout requirements consistently separate production-like validation from live production enforcement? [Consistency, Spec §FR-017, §FR-019, Quickstart §7]
- [x] CHK011 Do data-boundary requirements align with constitution rules for owner-controlled storage and secret discipline? [Consistency, Constitution Principle III, Spec §FR-029]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK012 Are cross-tenant read/write/delete success criteria measurable at 100% probe coverage? [Measurability, Spec §SC-003, §SC-004]
- [x] CHK013 Are missing-context and maintenance-context outcomes measurable without relying on customer data? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002, §SC-006, §SC-007]
- [x] CHK014 Are content/secret scan expectations measurable with a zero-leak target? [Measurability, Spec §SC-009]

## Scenario And Edge Case Coverage

- [x] CHK015 Are primary, alternate, exception, and recovery security scenarios represented across user stories and edge cases? [Coverage, Spec §User Scenarios, §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK016 Are guessed foreign identifiers, omitted workspace predicates, and inherited-scope rows addressed in requirements? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases, Data Model §Inherited Workspace Scope]
- [x] CHK017 Are downstream dashboard/share/download/delete surfaces explicitly excluded while still protected by future isolation contracts? [Coverage, Spec §FR-024, §SC-010]

## Dependencies And Assumptions

- [x] CHK018 Are PostgreSQL-specific enforcement assumptions separated from SQLite/local test limitations? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions, Plan §Technical Context]
- [x] CHK019 Are external dependency boundaries for MediaScribe, MinIO, Temporal, and Langfuse preserved without adding new egress behavior? [Dependency, Spec §FR-029, Constitution Principle III]
